mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_role WHERE name = #{role.name} and organization_id = #{role.organizationId} limit 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_role WHERE name = #{role.name} and organization_id = (select organization_id from sys_role where id = #{role.id}) and id != #{role.id} limit 1

select id, name from sys_role where id in
#{id}
select id from sys_role where internal = 1
select pos from sys_role where organization_id = #{orgId} order by pos desc limit 1
select id, name, internal, data_scope, organization_id, pos from sys_role where organization_id = #{orgId} order by pos asc
mapper.update: update sys_role set pos = pos - 1 where pos > #{start} and pos <= #{end}
update sys_role set pos = pos + 1 where pos >= #{start} and pos < #{end}
